## Author's merge checklist

- [ ] This is a short-lived feature/fix/docs/chore branch, not a direct change to `main`.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and removed unrelated changes, secrets, private data, and local handoff notes.
- [ ] I fetched current `origin/main`, integrated any new commits, and resolved conflicts without discarding another contributor's work.
- [ ] The PR is mergeable; the latest branch changes are tested against current `main` and **CI / Quality gate** is successful. I will recheck if either branch changes before merging.
- [ ] Required behavior evidence and affected documentation are included; skipped checks and synthetic results are labelled honestly.
- [ ] Relevant review conversations are resolved. Zero PR approvals are required; if I have authorized write access, I may squash-merge my own eligible PR after completing these checks.
- [ ] Any separately required non-author course-artifact review or unresolved acceptance gate is recorded rather than silently waived.

Use squash merge; merged branches are deleted automatically. GitHub does not allow self-approval; author self-review is not an approval event, and technical peer review is optional. The repository is public with enforced `main` protection, including for administrators: PRs, successful required `Quality gate` checks against up-to-date `main`, resolved conversations, and linear history are required; force pushes and deletion of `main` are blocked. Required approvals remain zero. Anyone may read, fork, and propose a PR, but only authorized writers may push repository branches or merge eligible PRs. Public source does not deploy the application or authorize access to private contributor/user data; sanitize all shared evidence. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/kim-913/action-inbox-mscs2101/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the canonical policy.
